programs.detail: Supreme Court held 2026-02-20 that IEEPA does not authorize tariffs. Entire 9903.01.xx layer eliminated prospectively, including the 9903.01.33 auto-parts carve-out. Ruling did not touch Section 232 or Section 301.

10% global surcharge expired by operation of law 12:01 a.m. 2026-07-24 (150 days after effect). No extension legislation. 301-FL turned on the same instant — 301-FL is the functional replacement, not an addition.
programs.compute_caveat: Historical only — apply when Entry Date is 2026-02-24..2026-07-23

programs.detail: Section 301 Forced Labor, CSMS #69326983, effective 2026-07-24 (headings mainly 9903.05.20+). No sunset. Mutually exclusive with Section 232 autos/parts — 232 wins via 9903.05.90 suppression. Brazil country 301 (9903.05.01–.09) is a separate program that can stack with FL (e.g. BR → .01 + .27).

Proclamation 10908. Passenger vehicles/light trucks auto-apply from the CSMS #64624801 list. Default heading 9903.94.01 @ 25% additional. Origin splits (COO + date + Column 1): JP 9903.94.40/.41 from 2025-09-16; EU 9903.94.50/.51 from 2025-08-01; KR 9903.94.60/.61 from 2025-11-01. Auto-parts annex default 9903.94.05; JP/EU/KR/UK parts use combined-cap headings. MHDV is a separate program (Proclamation 10984).

Proclamation 10984 / CSMS #66665333, effective 2025-11-01. MHDV vehicles 9903.74.01 @ 25%, buses 9903.74.02 @ 10% from the published HTS lists. MHDV parts 9903.74.08 is claim-gated (9903.74.11 exists for listed articles that are not MHDV parts). Not subject to 232 metals or wood when MHDV applies.
Proclamation 10976 / CSMS #66492057, effective 2025-10-14. Softwood 9903.76.01 @ 10%. Upholstered furniture and kitchen cabinets 25% (UK 10% / JP 15% / EU 15%). Autos 232 wins if both apply.

January 14, 2026 proclamation / CSMS #67400472, effective 2026-01-15. 9903.79.01 @ 25% only when HTS is 8471.50 / 8471.80 / 8473.30 AND Note 39(b) TPP/DRAM params are claimed (flags.s232_semiconductor). 0% headings .02–.09 are claim-gated exclusions. Claimed .01 wins over autos/MHDV/metals.
programs.compute_caveat: Do not infer TPP/DRAM bandwidth from HTS — duty path is claim-gated

programs.detail: CSMS #68253075 / U.S. note 16. 9903.82.02 assesses +50% on metal-content value (R4). 9903.82.09 assesses +25% on entered value for copper articles and derivative aluminum/steel. Mutually exclusive with 301-FL → 9903.05.90. Suppresses Sec 122 via 9903.03.06 (R2b). Chapter triage 72–74/76; annex derivatives outside those chapters are claim-gated when 9903.82.09 / 9903.03.06 are filed.
programs.compute_caveat: Do not fold into parts TOTAL

programs.detail: Proclamation 11020 / CSMS #69395344, #69415934. Patented pharmaceutical articles and ingredients (Ch.29/30). Default 9903.04.60 @ 100% combined Col-1+232; JP/EU/KR/CH/LI 9903.04.62 @ 15% combined; UK 9903.04.63 @ 0% additional from 2026-07-31. Generic 9903.04.67 @ 0%. Claim-gated (s232_pharma_patented / s232_pharma_generic). Suppresses 301-FL. Distinct from 301-FL pharmaceutical-use 9903.05.89 (Note 52(e)).
programs.compute_caveat: Do not infer patented vs generic from HTS. Combined Col-1+232 mechanic TBC on some headings — report rate, warn on total.

programs.detail: Legacy China 301 lists (U.S. note 20). NOT suppressed by 232 — both report, 301 first. Also stacks with Sec 122 (9903.03.01) when the line is outside the 232 universe. Continues in the 301-FL era alongside 9903.05.xx. Superseded on a given HTS by the four-year review heading when U.S. note 31 applies.

China 301 four-year review (89 FR 76581 / CSMS #62411889 / U.S. note 31). Products of China. 9903.91.01 +25% from 2024-09-27 covers steel/aluminum (incl. 7601.10.30) and listed minerals/battery parts. Later waves: .02 solar 50% (2024-09-27), .03 EVs/syringes 100% (2024-09-27), .04 facemasks 25% (2025 only), .05 semiconductors 50% (2025-01-01), .06 graphite/magnets/Li-ion 25% (2026-01-01), .07 masks 50% (2026-01-01), .08 gloves 100% (2026-01-01). Stacks with 232 (R2); replaces 9903.88.xx for the same HTS. Ship-to-shore cranes 9903.92.10 are claim-gated.

CSMS #69302472 / 91 FR 45516. Additional 25% on products of Brazil from 2026-07-22. Exempt headings 9903.05.02–.09 (232 universe → .07). Distinct from 301-FL Brazil flat 9903.05.27 (12.5% from 2026-07-24); both stack when applicable (FR note 50).

Section 338 (19 U.S.C. §1338) additional 50% on certain products of Canada. CSMS #69606660 / #69668138 / Proclamations 11046–11048, 11056. Original effective 2026-08-19 was suspended through 2026-08-21; live from 12:01 a.m. EST 2026-08-22. Product-of-Canada test (ISO CA; CATAIR X-codes normalize to CA). USMCA does not exempt. Drawback eligible. Note 51(c) 9903.03.15 when a 232-family heading already applies; 9903.03.16 civil aircraft needs civil_aircraft_gn6. Stacks on 301-FL / China 301 / AD/CVD / MPF/HMF. Evaluate after 232-family; report after Section 301 and before Section 232 on the 7501 (CSMS #69668138).
programs.compute_caveat: Do not apply during 2026-08-19–2026-08-21 suspension. Do not suppress because of SPI/USMCA.

programs.detail: Section 201 quartz surface products TRQ. U.S. note 41 / 31 July 2026 proclamation. Live 2026-08-15 through 2030-08-14. Covered HTS 6810.99.0020, 6810.99.0040, 7020.00.6000. Year 1 in-quota 25% / over-quota 50%, then steps down. Vietnam, China, India, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, Turkey are in scope; CA/MX/KR/FTA/CBERA/listed developing countries are exempt. Stacks with 301-FL (does not suppress). Default in-quota; over-quota is a claim. AD/CVD is separate.
programs.compute_caveat: Line-level assessment cannot see remaining quarterly quota — default 9903.45.30 and warn.

programs.detail: Section 232 unmanned aircraft systems. Proclamation 11055 / U.S. note 43, effective 2026-09-03. Large UAS 8806.24/.29/.94/.99 auto 9903.08.21 @ 100%. Small UAS 8806.21–.23/.91–.93 auto 9903.08.22 @ 25% unless thermal is claimed (then .21 @ 100%). Docking 8504.40.9580 / 8537.10.9170 and 8807 parts are claim-gated. Suppresses 301-FL. Partner 10/15% caps are rate-known but combined mechanic TBC. Annex III 8807 @ 25% from 2027-02-09.
programs.compute_caveat: Do not auto-apply 100% on general-purpose docking HTS. Thermal vs non-thermal on overlapping 8806 stems is claim-gated for the 100% path.
